title: Head of Private Sales, Watches
description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S 

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE 

- The Head of Private Sales is responsible for originating, sourcing, developing and executing private sale opportunities within the Luxury Division and Watches. Working closely with colleagues across Sotheby's global network, the role drives revenue growth by cultivating relationships with new and existing clients, identifying opportunities to buy and sell privately, and delivering exceptional client service throughout the transaction process.

- The role serves as the senior commercial lead for private sales within Watches and is accountable for driving revenue growth through exceptional client engagement, business development and transaction execution.

- Working closely with colleagues across Sotheby's global network, the role leverages deep market knowledge, strong client relationships and commercial acumen to identify opportunities, source property, facilitate transactions and deliver exceptional client outcomes. The successful candidate will play a critical role in expanding Sotheby's market presence, increasing private sale activity and strengthening relationships with collectors, consignors, dealers, advisors and other key market participants.

- The role acts as a senior commercial representative for Watches, partnering with specialists, Client Development teams and colleagues across the wider business to maximise private sale opportunities, grow market share and strengthen Sotheby's position within the luxury sector.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Private Sales

- Drive the growth of private sale transactions within Watches.

- Originate, negotiate and execute private sale transactions, leveraging Sotheby's global network and client base to identify opportunities.

- Lead the sourcing and origination of exceptional property within Watches, leveraging personal networks, market intelligence and Sotheby's global platform to secure opportunities for both private sale and auction.

- Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of private sale opportunities through proactive client engagement and business development activities.

- Work closely with Private Sales Strategy, Client Development and Specialist teams to identify client priorities, create action plans and generate transaction opportunities

- Maintain an exceptionally high level of client service, cultivating strong relationships with new and existing ultra-high-net-worth clients, collectors, dealers, advisors and other market participants.

- Actively source property for private sale and identify opportunities to place property with existing and prospective buyers.

- Participate in pricing, valuation and transaction discussions relating to private sale property.

- Collaborate across departments and categories to maximise cross-selling opportunities and enhance client engagement.

- Maintain accurate records of client interactions and opportunities within Sotheby's systems.

- Identify opportunities to transition property and clients between auction and private channels to maximise commercial outcomes for clients and Sotheby’s.

- Partner with auction teams to ensure opportunities across auction and private sale channels are fully leveraged.

- Business Development & Strategic Growth

- Contribute to the development and execution of strategies designed to grow private sales revenue within Watches.

- Identify new business opportunities, emerging market trends and collecting behaviours to support commercial growth.

- Maintain a deep understanding of Watches-specific market dynamics and competitive activity, using market insights to identify opportunities and inform business strategy.

- Work with leadership and specialist teams to develop initiatives that attract new clients and deepen existing client relationships.

- Support Watches-focused events, exhibitions, partnerships, private selling initiatives and other activities that generate business opportunities and increase market visibility.

- Represent client interests and market intelligence in discussions relating to business planning and growth initiatives.

- Client Relationship Management

- Build and maintain long-term relationships with key collectors, buyers, consignors, advisors and industry contacts.

- Own relationships with strategic clients and market participants within Watches, developing tailored approaches to drive acquisition, retention and transaction activity.

- Deliver a highly personalised and consultative client experience.

- Act as a trusted advisor to clients by providing market insight, collecting expertise and transaction guidance.

- Collaborate with Client Development colleagues to identify and engage priority clients globall

- Watches Representation & Brand Ambassadorship

- Act as an ambassador for Sotheby's and Watches both internally and externally.

- Maintain a high profile within the Watches market through attendance at fairs, exhibitions, industry events, client functions and other relevant activities.

- Develop and maintain relationships with key industry stakeholders to enhance Sotheby's visibility and access to commercial opportunities.

- Support departmental initiatives to engage new audiences and grow awareness of Watches.

- Contribute to media, content, social media and thought leadership opportunities where appropriate.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES 

- 8+ years of professional and relevant experience within the luxury goods, art, collectibles or related markets

- Demonstrable success in originating and executing high-value transactions and developing strong client relationships.

- Deep understanding of the luxury market and its participants.

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify and convert opportunities into revenue.

- Excellent interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills.

- Ability to communicate effectively with clients and colleagues at all levels.

- Proven ability to build credibility and trust with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively across departments and regions.

- Numerate and detail-oriented.

- Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications and relevant business systems. 

- Educated to degree level or equivalent relevant professional experience.

- Additional language skills would be advantageous.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default 

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here !

Purpose of the role: 

Proton is growing fast as more people worldwide seek greater control over their online privacy. To support that growth, we're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a team on one of our upcoming products.

You'll join the engineering leadership team, helping turn technical strategy into execution and contributing to a more privacy centric internet. title: Manufacturing Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE 

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION 

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT 

You will support the industrialisation of production processes for magnet production, contributing directly to the execution of key activities within Proxima’s magnet program.

You will play a central role in designing, testing and scaling up a wide array of production processes such as welding, bonding, sealing and coating.

You will be part of the team bridging manufacturing technology for first prototypes to full scale manufacturing

You will operate across a wide range of technical tasks, from design and engineering to hands on production work, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Define the requirements for industrialised manufacturing equipment and processes, to ensure performance, repeatability and safe operation

- Contribute to the development of in process monitoring and non destructive testing

- Help to determine and justify quality requirements to ensure smooth manufacturing while keeping the required product performance

- Design jigs and tools for magnet industrialised production

- Collaborate closely with engineers and technicians across multiple teams

WHO YOU ARE 

- A master´s degree in mechanical, mechatronics or similar engineering field

- A wide experience in manufacturing process development, process monitoring and non destructive testing in an industrial setting

- Strong hands-on experience in production environments over a wide range of production processes (for ex. welding, machining, assembly, bonding)

- Hands on experience in prototyping and testing

- Proficient in creating development plans from start to finish for a new process

- Experience in trouble-shooting issues as they arise on production lines

- Ability to work across a variety of tasks in a dynamic environment

- Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

- Strong team player, able to collaborate closely with engineers and technical staff

- A high performer who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes.

NICE TO HAVE 

- Familiarity in both prototype manufacturing and industrial manufacturing

- Comfortable with CAD: good knowledge of Catia V5 or 3DExperience are considered as a plus

- A background in product testing and qualification in a regulated industry is a plus

- Exposure to SCADA systems or MES integration

- Knowledge of safety standards and risk assessments in automated environments

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

description:
WHO WE ARE

Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION 

Impact: Your simulations will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy.

Ownership: As part of a small, highly technical team, you will define modeling standards and influence core design decisions.

Frontier Engineering: Work at the intersection of high-field electromagnetics, cryogenics, and advanced numerical methods.

Collaboration: Join a team combining deep superconducting expertise with advanced computational capability to solve one of the hardest engineering challenges of our time.

YOUR IMPACT 

At Proxima Fusion, we are designing the first generation of fusion power plants to provide the world with clean, carbon-free energy. The heart of our reactor lies in its superconducting coils. These magnets operate at cryogenic temperatures, generate extreme magnetic fields, and must remain stable under complex electromagnetic and thermal transients.

We are looking for a Numerical Modeling Engineer to develop high-fidelity simulation tools that predict and de-risk the behavior of our superconducting magnets. Your work will span electromagnetic, thermal, and transient multiphysics modeling - including quench dynamics - and will directly inform design decisions for conductors, coils, and protection systems.

This role is not about running black-box simulations. It is about building robust numerical frameworks - combining commercial multiphysics tools with in-house developed models - to enable fast, reliable, physics-driven engineering decisions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

Your work will combine physics modeling, numerical implementation, and close collaboration with magnet designers and experimental teams. You will contribute across three primary domains:

1. Electromagnetic & Thermal Multiphysics Modeling 

You will develop predictive models of superconducting magnet behavior across steady-state and transient regimes.

- Electromagnetic Simulation: Model high-field magnet systems including current distribution, inductance, AC losses, and nonlinear material behavior.

- Thermal Modeling: Simulate heat generation, conduction, and cryogenic cooling performance under operational and fault conditions.

- Multiphysics Coupling: Develop coupled EM-thermal models to capture transient events such as current redistribution and localized heating.

- Quench Modeling: Implement and validate numerical frameworks to simulate quench initiation, propagation, and protection strategies.

- Model Validation: Correlate simulations with experimental data from conductor and coil tests to continuously refine predictive capability.

2. In-House Tool Development & Numerical Infrastructure 

Beyond commercial software, you will help build Proxima’s internal modeling backbone.

- Custom Solvers & Reduced-Order Models: Develop fast, scalable modeling tools for system-level studies and design iteration.

- Automation & Parametric Studies: Build robust pipelines for design sweeps, optimization, and uncertainty quantification.

- Code Development: Contribute to internal Python- or C++-based frameworks for magnet modeling and data post-processing.

- Verification & Benchmarking: Establish numerical best practices, validation procedures, and cross-comparison between tools.

- Scalability: Ensure models can scale from conductor-level physics to full magnet assemblies.

Experience with COMSOL or similar commercial multiphysics tools (ANSYS, Opera, etc.) is valuable, but building reliable, physics-based in-house tools is equally (if not more) important.

3. Design Integration & Engineering Decision Support 

Your models will not live in isolation — they will directly shape hardware.

- Design Feedback: Provide quantitative guidance on conductor layout, stabilization strategies, and protection schemes.

- Risk Assessment: Identify failure modes and quantify margins under realistic operating scenarios.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with magnet engineers, quench protection specialists, and test engineers.

- Documentation & Communication: Translate complex physics into clear engineering recommendations.

WHO YOU ARE 

We are looking for a rigorous numerical thinker who enjoys bridging fundamental physics and practical engineering.

Background: 

- Degree (MSc or PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Computational Engineering, or a related field.

Core Expertise: 

- Strong foundation in electromagnetics and physics-based numerical modeling (e.g., FEM, nonlinear coupled systems), with the ability to implement and extend models programmatically

- Experience with multiphysics and transient simulations (e.g., electromagnetic–thermal coupling, fast transients).

- Proficiency in at least one scientific programming language (Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar), with interest in developing internal modeling tools and workflows.

Valued Experience (not all required): 

- Electromagnetic numerical modeling

- COMSOL or other commercial FEM tools.

- Modeling of high-current or high-field devices.

- Thermal modeling and heat transfer in complex systems.

- Experience building internal engineering tools rather than relying purely on GUI-based workflows.

Mindset: 

- You question assumptions and validate results critically.

- You are comfortable building models from first principles.

- You thrive in a startup environment where tools, processes, and standards are still evolving.

Prior experience with superconductors or HTS magnets is a plus - but strong electromagnetic and numerical expertise is the primary requirement.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. title: Brand Designer
description:
🍇 About grape: 

Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. 

At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! 

Your role: 

Hi there. Janine here. I know, this is unconventional… I'm deviating from the regular job description script. Why? Because this role is different. The starting point for this role is different. And we want to communicate that clearly.

If you browse our website and think, "amazing opportunity for a rebrand", we are not for you. Because here's the truth: what you just saw isn't a draft. It's not a v1. It's the result of a year spent getting the fundamentals right and building a visual foundation we believe in for the long term. What you saw is the floor, not the ceiling. It's the minimum bar for anything we ship from here on out. No rebrand. No reset. Just continuous improvement.

We're now at the point where we're looking to build up in-house design, and we need someone who can put the brand before personal signature, buy into what you just saw, execute on it with the same care it was built with, and then, over the years, shape its trajectory and help develop it further.

Who are you designing for, you ask? Three very different audiences: HR, the CFO, and, most importantly, the insured person. Not the easiest of brief, since most of the industry still talks to people like they're a policy number, especially at their hardest moments. We want to change that. This is why your work matters so much. At every touchpoint. You're not just making things look good. You're deciding what it feels like to face this system on a day when someone has less capacity than usual to deal with it.

That's the job: breathe life into our brand with your design skills and branding expertise, ensuring we deliver high-quality design solutions that connect with our audiences, feel distinctively human, and feel distinctively us. 

The team, you ask?
At this stage of growth, most of us are generalists wearing many different hats each day. Outside of work, you might find us boating on the lake, snowboarding in Arosa, hiking in Appenzell, playing dress-up with our kids, or looking out the window in a classroom in Bern. A bunch of wonderful human beings, skilled in many different things in life. Each one is equally important in building this brand step by step, day by day.

P.S. No AI in the application process for this role! We look at every portfolio and read every cover letter. So, you are not wasting your time telling us why you want to join :)

Please add a link to your portfolio or attach it when applying.

What you’ll do: 

- Shape the brand story going forward.

- Execute on our new visual identity and help sharpen our brand guidelines.

- Lead design projects from concept through delivery.

- Bring your creative expertise and know-how to campaign planning just as much as to execution.

- Design and create digital and physical collateral for brand and marketing initiatives. 

- Review design work from external partners to ensure high quality and brand consistency.

What you’ll need: 

- You bring +6 years of experience, either from a branding/ creative agency or working within an in-house team.

- You have a proven track record of building brands, are able to adapt your designs to the respective brand, and are proficient at reviewing design materials to ensure cohesive execution.

- You are equally skilled in creative direction and creative execution, taking ownership and occasionally working with freelancers to speed up the process.

- Your strong aesthetic sensibility and passion for branding allow you to interpret the brand and deliver a unified narrative through your work.

- You excel at managing a variety of design projects simultaneously, collaborating effectively with both internal teams and external stakeholders.

- Proven experience leading or managing a technical team, with strong people-leadership skills
- Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
- Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
- A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
- A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
- Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations

Your Profile

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
About BJAK 

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing 

- Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

- Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

- Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

- Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

- Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

- Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

- Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. 

What you'll need 

- Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

- Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

- Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

- AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

- Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap 

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch 

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds 

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted 

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location 

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.

YOUR MISSION - Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
- Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
- Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
- Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
- Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.

title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability 

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer. 

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.

YOUR MISSION - PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
- Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
- Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
- Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
- Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
- Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
- Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
- OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary

YOUR PROFILE - 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
- Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
- Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
- Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
- Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
- Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
- Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
- Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
- Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen

title: Senior Associate (m/w/d) Restrukturierung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung
description:
Es kommt drauf an - wo und mit wem man arbeitet! Vollzeit | unbefristet | zu sofort 

Wenn Finanzierung, Strategie und Recht zusammenfinden müssen, kommt es auf Menschen an, die den Überblick behalten. 

Wir beraten unsere Mandanten mit klarem Blick für das Machbare: von der frühzeitigen Krisenerkennung und der Restrukturierung von Finanzierungen über StaRUG-Strukturen bis hin zu komplexen M&A- und Carve-out-Prozessen. Dabei verbinden wir rechtliche Präzision mit wirtschaftlichem Verständnis und arbeiten eng mit unseren Experten aus Corporate, M&A, Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung zusammen. 
Für unser wachsendes Restrukturierungsteam suchen wir Sie als Senior Associate (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Finanzierung. Sie arbeiten unmittelbar mit Mandanten und Finanzierungspartnern, übernehmen früh Verantwortung und gestalten anspruchsvolle Lösungen aktiv mit. 

Ihre Aufgaben - Sie beraten Unternehmen, Gesellschafter und Finanzierungspartner in Krisen- und Restrukturierungssituationen. 
- Sie begleiten vorinsolvenzliche Restrukturierungen, insbesondere StaRUG -Verfahren. 
- Sie gestalten und verhandeln Sanierungsvereinbarungen sowie Kredit- und Finanzierungsverträge. 
- Sie begleiten M&A-Transaktionen mit finanzierungsrechtlichem Schwerpunkt. 
- Sie übernehmen eigene Mandatsverantwortung und gestalten den weiteren Ausbau unseres Restrukturierungsbereichs aktiv mit. 

Ihr Profil - Volljurist/in mit überdurchschnittlichen Examina 
- Min. vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Restrukturierungs- oder Insolvenzberatung 
- Unternehmerisches und wirtschaftliches Verständnis 
- Strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise 
- Teamplayer mit sicherem Auftreten und Freude am Mandantenkontakt 
- Ausgeprägte Affinität zu digitalen Arbeitsweisen und neuen Technologien sowie die Bereitschaft, deren Einsatz in der Mandatsarbeit weiterzuentwickeln 
- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse 

Warum wir? - Mandate mit Wirkung: Sie arbeiten an Situationen, in denen rechtliche Entscheidungen unmittelbare wirtschaftliche Bedeutung haben – und helfen Mandanten, wieder Handlungsspielraum zu gewinnen. 
- Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit : Rechtsanwälte, Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater und Restrukturierungsexperten sitzen bei uns unter einem Dach. Das ermöglicht kurze Wege und Lösungen, die rechtliche, finanzielle und steuerliche Perspektiven verbinden. 
- Technologie im Wandel : KI und Digitalisierung verändern auch die Arbeit in der Restrukturierung. Bei BRL erleben Sie diese Entwicklung nicht nur bei unseren Mandanten, sondern gestalten sie in einer multidisziplinären Kanzlei mit. 
- Verantwortung und Entwicklung : Sie erhalten früh direkten Mandantenkontakt, übernehmen Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenbereiche und entwickeln sich in einem strategisch wachsenden Beratungsfeld weiter. 
- Ein Team auf Augenhöhe : Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, kommunizieren offen und unterstützen einander auch dann, wenn Mandate komplex und zeitkritisch werden.
- Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten. 
- Zusätzliche Vorteile: Individuelle Weiterbildung, Mobilitätszuschüsse.

title: Senior Ground Software Engineer
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability 

At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do 

- 
Design and develop ground software used for mission preparation, execution, and monitoring of hypersonic systems. 

- 
Build robust, user facing applications for Linux and Windows environments that support operators and engineers during real missions. 

- 
Implement high performance C++ software with a focus on reliability, usability, and maintainability. 

- 
Develop intuitive user interfaces and workflows to visualise system state, mission data, and operational status. 

- 
Integrate ground software with simulation, test, and live system interfaces to support end to end operations. 

- 
Work closely with systems, GNC, test, and operations teams to translate mission needs into effective software tools. 

- 
Where useful, leverage UI frameworks (e.g. Qt) and mapping or visualisation SDKs to accelerate development. 

Who you are 

- 
A Senior software engineer with 5+ years’ experience building ground or operator-facing software in aerospace, defence , or complex technical domains. 

- 
Comfortable developing user-facing applications on Linux and Windows, with an understanding of operational reliability. 

- 
Fluent in modern C++, with an instinct for performance, robustness, and clean architecture. 

- 
Someone who cares deeply about operator experience, clarity, and usability in high-pressure environments. 

- 
Experienced translating mission and system needs into practical software tools, not just features. 

- 
Pragmatic about tooling, with exposure to UI frameworks such as Qt and an interest in visualisation or mapping technologies. 

- 
Able to move quickly in a startup environment, balancing polish with delivery speed. 

- 
Motivated by building software that operators trust during real missions, not demo-only systems. 

What we offer 

- 
A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

- 
Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence , with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

- 
High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement , just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

- 
A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

- 
A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

- 
Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. 

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own: 

- Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.

- Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.

- Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.

- Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.

- Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.

- Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.

- Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.

What You Bring: 

- 6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

- Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.

- Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.

- Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.

- Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.

- Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

What Makes You Stand Out: 

- Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.

- Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.

- Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.

- Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal), batch and job-execution systems, or large-scale data processing pipelines.

- Experience defining and measuring platform adoption: developer-productivity instrumentation, NPS, or internal marketshare.

About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Wolt is a Finnish technology company known for its local commerce platform. From food delivery to grocery stores and cosmetics, we make cities better places to live by connecting people with the things they need. Our Global Creative Production team is currently undergoing a massive transformation, shifting from a reactive service center to an "upstream AI-Enabled growth engine".

We are looking for a Senior Creative Producer to join us at this pivotal moment. 

This is a 6-month fixed contract opportunity starting ASAP. 

Location: Helsinki, Berlin, Athens, Stockholm, Copenhagen 

What you’ll be doing

As the Senior Creative Producer, you will manage digital projects from brief to final delivery. You’ll thrive in cross-functional collaboration across different business departments such as B2B, Communication, New Verticals, and Wolt+ teams. You’ll own project timelines for successful deliveries, weekly standups, daily communication with stakeholders and creative teams, and the localization and QA process during the production of social and digital assets. 

You will own the end-to-end production of digital advertising projects, ensuring our creative assets are not only on-brand but also built for massive scale across global markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day organization of the team and daily communication from brief to delivery. 

Day-to-day in this role, you’ll: 

- End-to-End Delivery: Manage digital projects and multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch. Our deliverables touch social, in-app, DOOH, event collateral, and OOH. 

- Resource & Budget Control: Oversee project costs, timelines, and team allocations without losing creative quality. 

- Stakeholder Management: Align internal marketing teams, designers, and external agencies on project milestones and timelines. Daily and/or weekly status updates are crucial for the success of our projects. 

- Time Management & Multitasking : Excellent time management skills with the ability to set priorities, multitask, and meet deadlines. Our producers are working on multiple projects simultaneously, and projects might touch different surfaces each time.

Our humble expectations 

- Solid Production Experience: 8+ years in creative production or integrated campaign management, ideally within a high-growth tech environment or a progressive digital agency.

- Understanding of Media Plans : You have experience with specs and asset production across Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion layers. 

- Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage complex projects with multiple high-level stakeholders while maintaining high creative standards. Demonstrated success partnering with distributed teams across time zones and cultures

- Risk Management & Reporting : Ability to assess risks during production, find solutions, and share with management and stakeholders in a timely manner. 

- Organizational skills : Methodical in following a predetermined system to complete tasks and meticulous in paying close attention to small details without losing sight of the big picture.

- Strong work ethic and accountability : A proactive attitude and rigor on everyday tasks, a positive mindset despite ongoing changes, and an excitement to learn. Resourceful during productions; deciding and acting on whether to bring external and/or internal resources and self-motivated to lead the project to completion. Someone who doesn’t shy away from a challenge and follows through on commitments made. 

- Tech-Forward Mindset: You have a strong interest (and ideally experience) in AI-powered creative tools and generative workflows.

What we offer

- Shape the Future: You won’t just be filling a seat; you’ll be building the blueprint for how Wolt produces creative content for years to come.

- Innovation at Scale: Work at the forefront of AI and automation in the creative industry, moving from manual tasks to agentic workflows.

- Impact: Take ownership of strategic business priorities and see your work scale globally.

- Wolt Culture: Join a team that values ownership, heart, and a "get things done" attitude in a hybrid, flexible work environment.

Next steps

- Application Review: Our Production team will review your profile to see if your experience aligns with our strategy.

- TA Screen: A 30-minute introductory call to discuss your background and motivations.

- Hiring Manager Interview: A deep dive into your production philosophy with our Creative Production Lead.

- Loop: Competency & Operating Principles: a structured behavioural interview with the team.

- Working Session: a short case study and walk us through your thinking.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. Purpose of Position 

Own the product agenda for how AI creates real, measurable value across Awin — translating AI capability into shipped product outcomes, not experiments. 

Context

The next chapter of Awin's product strategy is defined by how deliberately we put AI to work — not as a slogan, but as a set of practical capabilities embedded into what we build and how the business runs. 

Most companies treat AI as a layer bolted onto existing product thinking. We want the opposite: a Head of Product who treats AI as core to the product strategy itself — where it belongs, what it should never touch, and how it compounds value over time rather than producing one-off wins. 

What you'll own 

- Product strategy for AI-driven value. Define where AI genuinely changes the economics or experience of our product — and where it doesn't. Prioritise like a product leader: value creation and value capture, not novelty. 

- Translate capability into roadmap. Convert what AI can practically do today into a prioritised, sequenced product agenda with clear outcomes — not a lab of disconnected pilots. 

- Own outcomes, not outputs. Every initiative under your remit is judged on measurable business impact — adoption, efficiency, revenue, or customer outcome — not on whether something "uses AI." 

- Partner at exec level. Work directly with leadership to align AI investment with company priorities, and defend that investment in commercial terms. 

- Lead a product team. Hire and develop the product talent needed to execute — with real ownership over people and budget. 

- Set the standard for build vs. buy. Make disciplined calls on when to adopt existing AI tooling versus build proprietary capability, with opportunity cost as the deciding factor. 

- Champion practical adoption over theatre. Internal and external users are your test of success — if a capability isn't used, it isn't done. 

Who you are 

- Product leader with technical fluency. You've run product organisations and you understand, in practical terms, where AI creates leverage versus where it's a distraction. 

- Outcome-obsessed. You think in business impact first, technology second. 

- Commercially sharp. You can defend a roadmap in P&L terms as comfortably as in a product review. 

- Credible with engineering. You can go deep enough on data, APIs, and model capability to make good calls, without needing to be the one building it. 

- A builder of teams, not just plans — you know how to hire and develop product talent that ships. 

What success looks like 

- A clear, prioritised AI product agenda in place; first initiatives shipped with measurable adoption. 

- A functioning product team; multiple AI-enabled capabilities live and driving demonstrable business outcomes.

- AI is a defining, differentiated part of Awin's product experience — not a side initiative, but core to how the product wins in market. 

What this role is not 

Not an automation function. Not a central bureaucracy that runs projects for other teams. Not a lab for AI experimentation without a business case. This is a product leadership role — where AI is the primary lens, not a side interest.

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

- Framework & Capability Building: Take diagnosed problems through to operational reality, building the tools, scoring frameworks, and processes that other teams adopt and rely on. 

- Leadership & Ownership: Manage multiple objectives concurrently, ensuring accountability for outcomes even where the path forward isn't well precedented. 

- Communication: Design and deliver insightful, visually compelling presentations that influence decision-making and align stakeholders on growth strategy

Personal attributes & Experience 

- Experience working in hypothesis-led, problem-solving environments (e.g. high-growth start-ups, consulting or similar) is a plus.

- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and navigate complex, ambiguous problems using structured thinking.

description:

The Role 

We are looking for a brilliant and motivated Junior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this role, you will help us measure, optimize, and supercharge our marketing investments across our core brands, with a strong focus on our mathematical and econometric modelling frameworks. 

You will have a unique opportunity to develop a dual profile: a rigorous data scientist who can manipulate complex datasets and build advanced models, and a strategic partner who translates those insights into clear growth strategies. You will step into a key position, taking hands-on ownership of our Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) pipeline and helping us bridge the gap between statistical modelling, incrementality testing, and real-world multi-million-pound budget decisions. 

At LiveScore Group, we’re the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We’re proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan’s passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don’t just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it’s our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition.

As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you’re good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you’re passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! 

Key Responsibilities 

- Hands-on Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): Play a key role in our end-to-end MMM pipeline. You will be responsible for gathering, cleaning, and structuring time-series marketing data (spend, impressions, external factors) and building/refining statistical models to measure the ROI of our channels. 

- Model Calibration & Triangulation: Help calibrate our MMM outputs using results from incrementality testing. You will actively use ground-truth experimental data (e.g., GeoX tests, attribution model). 

- Budget Scenario Planning: Translate model outputs into actionable simulation tools and optimization scenarios. You will help stakeholders answer critical "what-if" questions regarding budget reallocations and product splits. 

- User Data & Performance Analytics: Use SQL to deep-dive into first-party user data and tracking key KPIs.

- Data Quality & Pipeline Ownership: Collaborate with our Data Engineering teams to automate data ingestion pipelines, ensuring high-quality, model-ready inputs from ad-platforms, attribution tools, and internal databases. 

- Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex econometric, Bayesian, or machine learning concepts into clear, commercial, and highly visual recommendations for marketing team leads and senior leadership. 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

- Proven experience or a degree in a highly quantitative field (e.g., Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or Engineering).

- Python (or R) proficiency: Solid programming foundations for data manipulation (pandas, numpy), statistical modeling, and machine learning (we primarily use Python). 

- Strong SQL skills: Comfortable writing efficient, structured queries to extract and aggregate massive datasets from relational databases. 

- MMM Frameworks: Exposure to or strong interest in modern open-source MMM libraries (e.g., Meta's Robyn, Google's Meridian, or PyMC/Bayesian workflows). 

- Solid foundation in econometrics, time-series analysis, and regression modeling (OLS, Ridge/Lasso, Bayesian regression). 

- Good understanding of testing and experimentation methodologies (A/B testing, GeoX testing, hypothesis testing, and statistics like MDE and bias analysis). 

- A keen interest in marketing dynamics (customer acquisition, CAC, CPA, ROI, and media attribution).

- We welcome applications from recent graduates and early career professionals, including candidates who have gained initial experience in an agency or client side environment, ideally with exposure to Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), marketing effectiveness, or related marketing analytics.

title: Software Engineer (Machine Learning)
description:
About Netcraft 

Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We’re a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.

Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.

That passion shapes how we work, too. We’re proud of our talented team and the value each person brings, and we’ve built a workplace where people feel supported and inspired. From strong benefits and wellness programs to meaningful collaboration and team connection. 

The role 

We are looking for an engineer who wants to apply ML to a real adversarial problem, where attackers actively evolve to evade you and turn to increasingly complicated schemes. As part of the Novel Classification team, you’ll use machine learning and AI to identify fraudulent content on the Internet, from phishing sites to the full breadth of online scams. 

You’ll learn from experienced engineers and see your ideas in production within weeks, driving the automated blocking and takedowns that disrupt cybercrime at scale. Recent projects include multi-modal embeddings that power classification and search, LLM classifiers, computer vision models for logo detection, and ensemble predictors that combine visual and semantic signals. We keep a close eye on the field and adopt new models and techniques early when they look promising. 

You’ll work across the full lifecycle: training and evaluating models, serving them on our GPU-backed Kubernetes clusters, wiring them into production classification systems, and watching how they behave against live attack traffic. 

Day to day, you’ll be: 

- Building, evaluating and tuning the classifiers that decide what gets blocked and taken down. 

- Deploying and operating model serving infrastructure on Kubernetes, including LLM inference (e.g. vLLM).

- Optimising models for high-volume, low-cost serving.

- Running experiments against live data, measuring precision, recall and false positive rates, and using the results to decide what ships.

- Integrating models into our production classification platforms.

- Building the pipelines and monitoring behind the models: feature extraction, scheduled retraining, experiment tracking, and the metrics that prove a solution works.

- Investigating and fixing issues in production, from model regressions to performance bottlenecks.

- Working across the business with engineers and analysts who depend on our classifiers. 

What you’ll need to be successful 

- Strong web fundamentals: HTTP, DNS, and above all how websites work, from request to rendered page. You'll use them both to understand the resources we classify and to build high-performance webservers. 

- A working understanding of machine learning fundamentals, such as training, evaluation, overfitting and precision/recall trade-offs. This could come from industry, research or substantial personal projects.

- Good written and verbal communication skills. The work the team does is complex, and we must be able to articulate the impact of our work clearly and concisely, to a wide range of stakeholders.

- An empirical mindset. You design experiments, measure outcomes, and use metrics to validate and demonstrate impact.

- Willingness to learn Go and modern Perl, including asynchronous programming.

- Strong attention to detail and a real sense of responsibility. Customers act on our classifications, and Netcraft's reputation depends on getting them right. 

Bonus points if you have 

- A keen interest in cybercrime or cybersecurity. 

- Experience fine-tuning models, including evaluation.

- Experience with LLM agents, evaluation & serving (e.g. vLLM or llama.cpp).

- Familiarity with cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes, Flux, Argo and API gateways.

- Experience with multi-modal models, embeddings or similarity search at scale.

- Experience with ML experiment tracking and workflow tooling, such as MLflow or Argo Workflows.

- Experience with SQL databases, including writing and optimising queries against large datasets. 

Preferably based in London, though Manchester and Bath are also options. 

At Netcraft we strongly believe in individual growth and development. Even if you can't tick every box above right now, please don't let it put you off applying. 

The Reward Package: 

- 33 days annual leave - includes public holidays which can be worked if you prefer

- Generous enhanced family leave and pay

- Enhanced company sick pay from day one of employment, with additional support after your first six months’ service

- Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings

- Private health cover, including access to a private GP service

- Life Assurance at 4 x salary

- Equity tracking scheme (eligibility criteria apply) - allowing you share in Netcraft's long term success

- Hybrid and flexible working options

- Meals, snacks, and drinks provided in the office

- Comprehensive health, safety, and wellness service available 24/7 for you and your family

- Two paid Learning & Development days per year plus access to learning resources such as Udemy and Coursera to support your career

- Two Volunteering Days per year, to allow you to contribute to your wider community or charity

- Employee Referral Bonus scheme

- Spot reward bonus scheme to reward truly outstanding contributions 

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 

This is deeply important to us. Through our ally network, we support under-represented groups and maintain a working environment free from bias, harassment, or discrimination. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

We’re also happy to make adjustments to the hiring process to ensure every candidate can participate fully.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalized than ever before.  Learn more at geniussports.com.   

The Role 

You will join one of our established high-performing teams within the Betting division, as we invest in our core and future Betting products. You will be focusing on the delivery of technical and product-focused initiatives, to expand and scale up our industry's leading Sportsbook and Risk Management products. 

One example is our Advanced Risk team, who were set up to challenge conventional wisdom about risk management for sports betting operators. Using new measures of liability that take account of correlations between different markets on an event, and by monitoring betting patterns from the moment an event is opened for betting, we apply margins asymmetrically in a way that helps operators to make higher profit margins, reduce volatility and improve customer experience with greater uptime and fewer rejected bets. Our software provides customers with a new level of flexibility over the way they manage their Sportsbooks to meet their financial objectives. Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé . 

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Contrôle de Gestion, vous serez au cœur du pilotage de la performance et de la structuration de la donnée financière. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes opérationnelles et la finance : analyser, fiabiliser et automatiser l'information pour aider les équipes à décider vite et bien, sur la performance commerciale comme sur les dépenses d'exploitation.

Au-delà du contrôle de gestion classique, vous contribuerez directement à nos chantiers data : construction d'une base CA/Marge unifiée et automatisation des reportings récurrents. Un vrai terrain de jeu pour un profil qui aime croiser finance et outils.

Missions 

1. Analyse de la performance commerciale et du forecast

- Assurer l'analyse hebdomadaire des installations, du sell-out et des stocks distributeurs.
- Mettre à jour ces données dans notre outil de planification Anaplan et alerter sur les principales variations.
- Participer aux revues mensuelles de forecast avec les équipes commerciales pour analyser la cohérence et les écarts au budget.
2. Suivi de la performance opérationnelle et des OPEX

- Aider l'équipe finance à déployer le suivi des dépenses d'exploitation (OPEX) par service.
- Analyser et présenter les suivis OPEX aux responsables budgétaires, avec un vrai rôle d'alerte sur les dérives.
3. Automatisation et fiabilisation du reporting

- Contribuer à la construction et à la fiabilisation de notre base de données CA/Marge (réconciliation multi-sources SAP et e-commerce).
- Automatiser des reportings récurrents (Net Margin, OPEX, Flash Finance) via requêtes et outils dédiés.
- Participer aux analyses liées aux nouveaux flux : migration Shopify, partenariats B2B et nouveaux projets d'intégration.
4. Gestion des outils et analyses ad-hoc

- Assurer la collecte, la mise à jour et la fiabilité des données dans nos outils de pilotage.
- Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles pour les autres services : prévisions d'installations pour le service client, estimation des volumes des nouveaux produits, etc.
Requirements 

- Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou cursus finance / data, en césure ou en fin d'études, avec une première approche du contrôle de gestion et un vrai intérêt pour la donnée.
- Excellente maîtrise d'Excel : formules avancées, TCD, modélisation.
- Appétence forte pour la data et l'automatisation. Des notions de SQL et / ou Python sont un vrai plus et pourront être développées pendant le stage.
- La connaissance d'Anaplan et/ou SAP est un atout.
- Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous gérez plusieurs sujets en parallèle.
- Autonome et curieux(se), vous prenez des initiatives et apprenez vite.
- Excellent(e) communicant(e), vous aimez le travail en équipe et savez interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés.
- Vous parlez couramment anglais.
Benefits 

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

- Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
- Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
- Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
- Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
- Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
- Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.
